error.invalid_auth: Cookie was rejected by SmartThings Find. Make sure you copied the JSESSIONID value (not the whole cookie header) from a tab where you are logged in.

user.title: Paste JSESSIONID cookie
user.description:
Samsung's QR code login flow no longer works (account.samsung.com was rebuilt). Until it is replaced you have to obtain the session cookie manually:

1. Open [smartthingsfind.samsung.com](https://smartthingsfind.samsung.com/) in a regular browser and log in.
2. Open DevTools → Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox) → Cookies → smartthingsfind.samsung.com.
3. Copy the value of the **JSESSIONID** cookie and paste it below.

The cookie usually stays valid for several weeks. When it expires Home Assistant will trigger a reauth and you repeat these steps.
